pool.text: The city was founded as a Russian border fort protecting the local frontier.
The settlement was officially granted town status during early administrative development.
Intensive growth began with the arrival of the Siberian Route connecting nearby towns.
Krasnoyarsk officially became the administrative centre of the Yeniseysk Governorate.
Urban growth continued further with the arrival of a new railroad.
Krasnoyarsk Krai was formed with the city designated as its administrative centre.
The most important labour camp known as Kraslag operated with two units.
Krasnoyarsk State Medical University was founded to provide higher medical education.
Krasnoyarsk State Agrarian University was established for agricultural sciences education.
Siberian State Aerospace University was founded to advance specialized aerospace education.
The Soviet Union admitted the radar station was a violation of agreements.
The appearance of the city gradually improved following a mayoral election.
The famous bridge was rejected for emergency inscription on the World Heritage List.
Siberian Federal University was founded by integrating four large higher education institutions.
A destructive fire broke out at the local airport destroying the terminal building.
A new decision was made to use tunnels to create a light rail system.
